welcome.speaker: Muhammad Jan
lines: Welcome to our village in Laghman. Walk with me to the Library; we will begin with a first hello.
Use the arrows or WASD to move. Stand next to a person and press E, Enter or Interact. The paths connect all four neighbourhoods.

actions.label: I will meet you at the Library

library.speaker: Muhammad Jan
lines: Our Library holds everything you learn. Let us practise recognising two greetings, selecting Pashto, and identifying my name. Your own name and gender are optional Library profile settings.

home.speaker: Muhammad Jan
lines: Welcome home. We can study descriptions together, or you can try the Day 1 challenge whenever you feel ready. You do not need to finish all four lessons first.

lake.speaker: Saleha
lines: Welcome to the lake. Let us learn the words for the world around us.

market.speaker: Edris
lines: Welcome to our market. There is plenty to learn among the stalls.

school.speaker: Ms Hameed
lines: Welcome to school. We will build on the words and forms you learn throughout the village.

reference.speaker: Library
lines: Your vocabulary, expressions and grammar reference are always available here. Voluntary Library practice awards no XP.
